question: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, each has a different age. Only two people are older than Q. P is older than Q but younger than O. M is older than R but younger than S. Only three people are younger than S. N is the youngest among all. The age of how many persons is between the ages of Q and R?
solution:
**Given**: Seven friends M, N, O, P, Q, R, and S

**STEP 1: **So first in the question, it is given that only two people are older than Q so the resulting framework will be 

__ > __ > Q > __ > __ > __ > __
